# Third-party licenses

<!-- Generated by make licenses (scripts/licenses.sh, scripts/security/third-party.mjs). Do not edit: make security fails when this file is not what the lock files give. -->

The production dependencies of this repository's five applications, as their lock files install them: 472 packages, each with the license it declares. A package installed in more than one version is listed once, with the license of each version, and the versions themselves are in the lock files. Development tools (linters, test runners, the end-to-end test's browser) are not distributed with the code and are not listed. Neither are the local stack's container images, which run as separate processes. The files of others that live in the repository itself come [after the summary](#files-of-third-parties-in-the-repository), and [NOTICE](../NOTICE) gives their notices.

This project is under the [MIT License](../LICENSE). Every license below is compatible with it, which `make security` checks on every run against the list in `scripts/security/compatibility.mjs`:

- **Permissive** licenses (MIT, ISC, BSD, Apache-2.0 and the like) ask to keep their notice, which each package carries.
- **Weak copyleft** licenses (LGPL, EPL, MPL) cover their library's files, used here as published: the library stays under its license, and this project's code stays MIT.
- **Font** licenses (OFL-1.1) cover the font itself, not the documents or the pages that use it.
- A package with a choice of licenses (`A OR B`) is used under the first compatible alternative.

### Excerpts in files of this project

- **Code lists, rules, messages and examples of the DIAN technical annex 1.9.** The codes and official names of section 13's tables, the codes and messages of the validation rules in sections 8 and 12 (in Spanish, as the annex writes them), and the values of the CUFE and CUDE examples in section 11, inside this project's files. In `backend/app/Modules/Reference/Enums/*.php`, `simulator/src/rules.ts`, `backend/app/Modules/Dian/Console/DianCheckCommand.php`, `backend/tests/Unit/Dian/DocumentKeyTest.php`. Part of the annex that Resolución 000165 of 2023 adopts, reproduced as published (article 41 of Ley 23 de 1982).

### Kept out of the repository

- **The DIAN toolbox v1.9 (schematron, code lists, examples, the annex).** make dian-toolbox downloads it from the DIAN into backend/storage/app/dian-toolbox, never committed, and checks its SHA-256; only make dian-schematron needs it.
- **The DIAN signature policy (politicadefirmav2.pdf).** Never downloaded: each signature names its URL and the SHA-256 digest of the official examples (backend/app/Modules/Dian/Signing/XadesSigner.php).
- **The certificate authorities of Amazon RDS (global-bundle.pem).** Downloaded into the image of the functions when it is built, pinned by its SHA-256 (backend/Dockerfile).
- **Stoplight Elements 8.4.2.** Loaded by the browser from unpkg.com for the API reference, pinned by Subresource Integrity (backend/resources/http/security-headers.json).
- **SaxonJS 2.7.0 and SchXslt 1.10.1.** Downloaded by make dian-schematron into a Docker volume (scripts/dian-schematron/run.sh).
- **`backend/resources/dian/examples/invoice-example.xml`**, removed: "Ejemplificación Impuesto especial para la estabilidad fiscal.xml", an example invoice of the DIAN toolbox v1.9. Support material that nothing in the repository reads; make dian-toolbox downloads the whole toolbox, with its SHA-256, when a check needs it.
